final:
rotl8(x: u8, k: int) -> u8 =
  pre k >= 0 and k <= 7
  post bits.count_ones(out) == bits.count_ones(x)
  ex rotl8(129, 1) == 3
  ex rotl8(1, 7) == 128
  ex rotl8(90, 0) == 90
  let v = int(x)
  let r = ((v << k) | (v >> (8 - k))) & 255
  r as u8
